technology_name: Pochonia chlamydosporia, a Biocontrol Agent Against Nematodes – Talc Formulation
problem_solved: Crop damage caused by plant parasitic nematodes
description: Talc-based formulation of Pochonia chlamydosporia developed for biological management of nematode infestations. The technology provides a microbial alternative for nematode control in agricultural systems.
applications:
Biopesticide and agricultural bio-input manufacturers
Horticulture, plantation, and commercial crop cultivation enterprises
Organic farming and sustainable agriculture initiatives
Agricultural input companies and crop protection service providers
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and integrated nematode management programs
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
